node.statement: Since C_j is a positive contraction and xi_j is a unit vector, 0<=alpha_j=<xi_j,C_j^*C_j xi_j><=1, so |1-alpha_j|=1-alpha_j. The component-construction bound 1-<xi_j,C_j^*C_j xi_j><=2*C_R*eta and ||Y_j||<=||Y|| now give ||P_jq(Y)-Y_j||=|1-alpha_j|*||Y_j||<=2*C_R*eta*||Y||, proving node 1.2.
